caption: I Caught Meta LYING on a Fact Check — Here’s Why 🧐
video_overlay_text_observed: Cover card: "This is not an “accident” 🤨". Inline pops: "THIS IS 100%". On-screen screenshot of a published Community Note reading "This video is AI. Marco Rubio did not say this." attached to the creator’s prior post, plus a screenshot of the state.gov transcript and a clip of an AI-policy talk.
audio_content_summary: Argues that a Community Note falsely labeling authentic footage of Secretary of State Marco Rubio as AI-generated is part of a broader pattern: pro-Israel advocacy moving into AI systems, and bot networks capable of manufacturing the cross-viewpoint consensus that Community Notes requires. Reads the state.gov transcript aloud to show the footage is genuine, plays a clip of an AI researcher describing a path to "correcting the digital world," cites Times of Israel reporting on bots amplifying Netanyahu, and closes on the Orwell line about rejecting the evidence of your eyes and ears.
implied_frame: Verified here: Rubio’s May 28, 2025 remarks are genuine and published in full on state.gov (2025-rubio-visa-antisemitism-001); Maya Ackerman’s AJC and Voice of the People remarks and the One Five Seven initiative are documented (2026-one-five-seven-ai-001); Meta’s Community Notes are contributor-written and published by a cross-viewpoint bridging algorithm, exactly as described (2026-meta-community-notes-001). Not established: that the Rubio policy revokes visas for criticizing Israel — the text says "foment hatred against our Jewish community" and leaves the threshold undefined; that the note on the prior post was placed by bots or coordinated at all — offered as "you can imagine," with no evidence tying any bot network to any specific note; that the Channel 12 bot findings (2026-israel-bot-network-001) extend beyond Israeli-language political amplification to Meta’s notes system. The genocide characterization and the reading of the AI initiative as a censorship program are contested framings, carried as attribution only.
capture_method: Pristine original media + metadata pulled from Instagram's CDN via yt-dlp; delivery webm derived once (VP9 video copied, audio normalized to -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP off the source AAC — no re-recording, no in-place re-encode).
video_download_status: Original pulled via yt-dlp (~23.3 MB); delivery ~24.3 MB webm.
